## Summary

Bramble Hill Dental: theft from an unattended bag of a projector and a sound bar at the insured's van, parked overnight. Declined under exclusion 7.1.

## Facts

Bramble Hill Dental reported the loss on 6 September 2026 under policy CC-1555 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at the insured's van, parked overnight [notice of loss]. The items are a projector and a sound bar [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 8 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4195 [police report]. The items were taken from an unattended bag [police report]. They had been left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy].

Exclusion 7.1 applies. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless it was in a locked container or locked room at the time. The items were unattended in a shared area and not in a locked container [police report], [policy].

Exclusion 7.5 does not decide the claim. The file does not state the date of the theft itself. The police report is dated 8 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss of 6 September 2026 [police report], [notice of loss]. Nothing in the file shows a gap of more than seven days [policy].

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a theft, and no gradual deterioration is described [police report], [policy].

## Decision

Not covered: exclusion 7.1 applies. The claim is declined, and the insured is told why in the terms of the policy.

## Reserve

No reserve is set: the claim is declined.
